title: Algites Defs Codegen vocabulary 1 keyword syntax for JSON Schema draft-06
description: Syntax constraints for proprietary source-code generation annotations. JSON Schema draft-03/04/06/07 do not support $vocabulary.

items.description: URI reference to a named Algites DataObject contract; resolved by Defs Codegen.

x-algites-defscodegen-extends.description: Ordered nominal direct parents of the generated interface; not a validation assertion.

x-algites-defscodegen-choice.description: Explicit Defs Codegen exclusive choice over sibling properties; minProperties=1, maxProperties=1 and additionalProperties=false ensure standard JSON validation where supported. May only appear in structural schema positions.

x-algites-defscodegen-key.description: Semantic identity constraint of a JSON/YAML additionalProperties map, scoped to the owning collection; id matches xs:key/@name, field-name matches the logical key field selected by xs:field. Does not change serialized property names.

id.description: Stable list-local identity constraint ID, matching xs:key/@name.

field-name.description: Logical name of the virtual map-key getter field, overriding multi_mapped_list_key_synthetic_getter.

x-algites-defscodegen-root-type-name.description: Optional explicit canonical name of the JSONDEFS/YAMLDEFS document-root generated type. Overrides the filename-derived name after naming-profile processing; it does not rename any $defs/definitions declarations or modify serialized fields. Only applies to a structural document root, never to a named nested subschema.
